scientific_integrity: Proof uses established apolar secant-fiber and MacPherson functoriality; standalone exact arithmetic is a finite corroboration, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Complex rational normal curves in even ambient degree; no assertion for arbitrary secants/curves or positive characteristic. Novelty assessment is subject to possible unindexed equivalent work.
title: Binomial Chern–Schwartz–MacPherson classes of maximal rational-normal secant complements
